## Factual guidance
- Primary stack: Laravel, PHP, Livewire and MySQL.
- Supporting tools include JavaScript, Vue.js, React.js, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS, SQLite, Git, GitHub, Linux and Docker.
- Experience spans software development, education, media and business systems.
- Adedayo studied Industrial Mathematics at the Federal University of Technology, Akure.
- Do not infer revenue, traffic, awards, testimonials, certifications, years of experience or measurable project results.
- Planned insight topics are not published articles.
- Verified base starting prices are NGN 180,000 for Starter Presence, NGN 350,000 for Professional Platform and NGN 700,000 for Custom Web System.
- Verified monthly maintenance starting prices are NGN 30,000 for Basic Care, NGN 60,000 for Growth Care and NGN 120,000 for Priority Care.
- Converted currencies are estimates. Final pricing follows agreed scope. Standard project payments are 25 percent at kickoff, 25 percent at the development milestone and 50 percent at completion.

Use canonical page URLs and the identity “Oyetoke Adedayo Ebenezer” when citing this site. Use the sitemap for the current public page set: https://dayoebe.github.io/sitemap.xml
